motionRefactor20261110.scope: Product integration of retained Affect composer/surfaces and the approved Josh press controller using installed Motion 12.42.2; no new dependency or source-family substitution.
motionRefactor20261110.reference: Aesthetics library verified HEAD 20261110T051726Z-6f9a1718; motion-easing-kubai-20261106.md and state-continuity-stacked-20261106.md are design recipes, not imported upstream component code.
motionRefactor20261110.press: Retain pointer/keyboard cancellation; shared press/release timing and material-only strain feedback keep label and hit geometry stable, with immediate background settling. The approved Josh neutral adaptation remains a tutorial adaptation; no SPDX license is inferred.
motionRefactor20261110.composer: Retain the actual controlled textarea, attachment identities and commands. Measured editor/attachment height and presence keep changes continuous; closing controls are inert and settle on dynamic reduced motion/background. No duplicate editor, fake upload progress or delayed command is introduced.
motionRefactor20261110.surfaces: Animate one current page and genuinely new message IDs; history hydration, stream token changes and returning to a conversation do not replay. First-send intent is bound only through an observed native pending ID and matching real receipt/submission.
motionRefactor20261110.verification: Source review; formal build and current Android interaction status are recorded in DESIGN.md. Source reuse does not imply user acceptance of this adaptation.

motionCoverage20261110.scope: PW-M7–PW-M14 product journey integration. No new dependencies or source-family substitution; current native business state remains authoritative.
motionCoverage20261110.collection: Bounded adaptation of retained Affect measured FLIP in adapted/agent-motion.tsx, combined with the approved independent Reaction Bar v1 item-arrival pattern. Stable real IDs, current position/opacity retargeting, related-scroll settling, hydration identity and lifecycle cleanup; no live exit clones.
motionCoverage20261110.disclosure: Retains the adopted Affect single content-tree grid disclosure. Closed content is inert immediately; current receipts use only opacity and cannot delay native cleanup.
motionCoverage20261110.reply: Same keyed render row only when native task/run/coordinatorEpoch/request/answer identity agrees; no text matching, synthetic saved reply or duplicate editor. Continued body does not replay new-message arrival.
motionCoverage20261110.steps: Continues the approved independent Nick archive adaptation already retained in execution-stepper.js, not author original code. Nested real trace children and stable node reconciliation replace demo rebuild/timer behavior; source archive and upstream bytes are unchanged.
motionCoverage20261110.media: Embla 8.6.0 retained; touch cancellation, reInit, visibility and reduced-motion settling added around the existing engine. Real phone/video/native-preview instances and authoritative input geometry remain unchanged by layout motion.
motionCoverage20261110.evidence: ../../docs/motion-research-20261110.md records the approved-reference boundaries, exact source reading, implementation map, build status and unverified Android experience. Implementation authorization is not visual acceptance.

motionDepth20261110.scope: PW-M15–PW-M19 deepen retained source adaptations after the v0.1.86 coverage release. No new source family or dependency; implementation approval is separate from visual acceptance.

replyPhase.adaptation: Retain fixed icon slot, current/leaving pure labels and measured label width. selectorResponse20261111.changes: Local provider owns transient picker state with unchanged children; scoped consumers preserve trigger semantics and native preview visibility.
